request: Our school library wants a simple catalogue of its books. The librarian should be able to add a book with its title, its author and how many copies the library owns. Students should be able to see all the books, and look at one book to see how many copies are still on the shelf. A student borrows a book by giving their name, and returns it when they are done; a student can only return a book they actually borrowed. When every copy of a book is out, nobody else can borrow it until a copy comes back.
summary:
I removed the way to add books, as you asked, and all of my checks passed.

**What changed:** the system no longer offers any way to add books, and attempts to add one are turned away. You'll load the books into the catalogue's storage yourselves.

**What students can still do**
- See every book, or look at one book to see how many copies are left on the shelf.
- Borrow a book by giving their name, and return it by giving the same name.

**Choices I made for you**
- Names are matched without caring about capital letters or extra spaces, so "Ann" and "ann" count as the same student.
- One student can borrow more than one copy of the same book.

**What is refused**
- Borrowing when no copies are left, or without a name.
- Returning a book that student hasn't borrowed.

**Not done or not tested:** I didn't build anything to read your file, so that part is up to you. Each book needs a title, an author and a number of copies. I didn't test loading real data from a file.
messages: I changed my mind: we don't want a way to add books. We will load the books from a CSV file ourselves.
